# FreshCuts Daily - AI-Friendly Site Information

## About
FreshCuts Daily is a premium fresh meat delivery service based in Bangalore, India. We deliver high-quality chicken, mutton, lamb, seafood, and fish products directly to customers' doorsteps.

## Products & Services
- **Chicken & Poultry**: Fresh chicken, duck, turkey, quail
- **Mutton & Lamb**: Fresh mutton, lamb chops, goat meat, keema
- **Seafood & Fish**: Fresh fish, prawns, crab, lobster, salmon, pomfret, surmai

## Location
We serve customers across Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

## Key Information
- Same-day delivery available
- Farm-fresh quality guaranteed
- Premium cuts and portions
- Hygienically packed products
- Wide variety of fresh meat products
